info.bio: Veruca Salt es una banda de rock alternativo y grunge, formada en 1993 en Chicago, Illinois, Estados Unidos. Sus miembros originales (para muchos la mejor formación de la banda) fueron Louise Post, Nina Gordon (ambas compositoras, cantantes y guitarristas), Steve Lack al bajo y Jim Shapiro (hermano de Nina Gordon) en la batería. El éxito no tardó en llegarles, pues desde el sencillo "Seether", incluido en su álbum debut American Thighs, mostraron sus cualidades: buen ritmo

scenes.name: Foxcore y riot grrrls
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: El hardcore había sido un fenómeno masculino; el movimiento «riot grrrl» introduce el «factor chica» en la ecuación de frustración, depresión, desesperación y rabia. Nace en Olympia (fanzines como «Girl Germs», el lema «Revolution Girl Style Now!») y bebe de las cantautoras neoyorquinas, las bandas femeninas californianas (Runaways, Frightwig, L7) y las británicas (Raincoats, Slits). Un movimiento fundado en las letras, no en la música: Mecca Normal, Bikini Kill de Kathleen Hanna (y luego Le Tigre), Bratmobile, Team Dresch, Hole de Courtney Love, Seven Year Bitch, Sleater-Kinney. En California, Mudwimin, 4 Non Blondes, Tribe 8, Tiger Trap, Donnas, Red Aunts, That Dog, Muffs; en el Medio Oeste, Babes In Toyland (Fontanelle, «un arte de emociones extremas») y Sugarsmack; Free Kitten y Luscious Jackson en Nueva York.

podcast.title: Great American Power Pop Band
podcast.body: Veruca Salt, bookended by Nina Gordon and Louise Post, is recognized as one of the great American power pop bands of the mid-1990s. "Veruchas Salt, bookended by Nina Gordon and Louise Post. They were one of the great American power pop bands of the middle 1990s."

podcast.title: Nirvana and Pearl Jam Influence
podcast.body: Like many bands of the era, Veruca Salt drew inspiration from the success of grunge giants such as Pearl Jam and Nirvana to begin creating their own music. "Like so many bands, they were inspired by the success of bands like Pearl Jam and Nirvana to start making their own music."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Non-Collaborative Songwriting
podcast.body: The band's leadership, Nina Gordon and Louise Post, managed songwriting in a unique, non-collaborative manner where the person who wrote a song was also the one who performed the lead vocals for it. "They handled all the songwriting, but not really in a collaborative way. The deal was, whoever wrote the song got to sing it."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Rapid Rise to Major Label
podcast.body: After performing only a couple of shows, Veruca Salt quickly gained attention, first being approached by the indie label Minty Fresh for a single. This single's success led to them opening a tour for Hole, who were signed to Geffen, ultimately resulting in Veruca Salt signing with Geffen as well. "After just a couple of shows, they were approached by an indie label called Minty Fresh."
